name: scratchbox-ide
description: Scratchbox IDE — Generative Canvas Studio, Visual Primitives, 3D Geospatial Engine, and AI Workspace
author: Scratchbox LLC

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/core run build && npm --prefix packages/cli run build && npm --prefix desktop-app run build
scripts.build:serve-public: tsc packages/core/src/node/spatial/GeoBoxPrecisionResectionService.ts packages/core/src/node/spatial/Google3DTileBlockoutPipelineService.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --noCheck --jsx react-jsx --rootDir packages/core/src --outDir build/serve-public-core
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p desktop-app && tsc --noEmit -p desktop-app/tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.lint: node scripts/lint_no_js_primitives.js && eslint packages/core/src desktop-app/src desktop-app/server desktop-app/electron --report-unused-disable-directives
scripts.omnispatial:build: mkdir -p build/omnispatial && clang++ -std=c++20 -O3 -I packages/core/src/native/3d-engine/include scripts/build_omnispatial_master_models.cpp -o build/omnispatial/build_master -lz && clang++ -std=c++20 -O3 -I packages/core/src/native/3d-engine/include scripts/render_tile_pathtraced.cpp -o build/omnispatial/render_pt -lz && build/omnispatial/build_master && build/omnispatial/render_pt scripts/config_stage1_clay.json && build/omnispatial/render_pt scripts/config_stage2_vector.json && build/omnispatial/render_pt scripts/config_stage3_pbr.json
